item.title: Kumamoto Basashi: Horse Sashimi — Guide
item.description: Basashi — raw horse meat served as sashimi — is Kumamoto’s most iconic local delicacy, and the prefecture is Japan’s foremost region for it. Thinly sliced fresh horse meat is served raw, like fish sashimi, and eaten dipped in a sweet soy sauce with grated ginger, garlic and spring onion. Far from gamey, good basashi is prized for being lean, subtly sweet, clean-tasting and surprisingly tender, with different cuts offering different textures — from lean red meat (akami) to richly marbled ‘toro’ cuts that melt in the mouth.
